title: Uniform Resolvent Estimates for the Discrete Schrödinger Operator in Higher Dimensions
summary: Let $H_0$ be the standard discrete Laplacian on $\mathbb Z^d$, $d\geq4$, let $R_0(z)=(H_0-z)^{-1}$, and let $p'$ denote the Hölder conjugate of $p$, with $p'=\infty$ when $p=1$. We establish uniform diagonal resolvent estimates from $\ell^p(\mathbb Z^d)$ to $\ell^{p'}(\mathbb Z^d)$ by proving local Fourier-decay bounds for surface measure on the Fermi surfaces of the lattice dispersion relation.
